<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the peaks in the aromatic region (≈110–150 ppm) are at 131.87, 129.70 (twice), 129.01 (twice) and 129.00 ppm. That accounts for six aromatic carbon atoms. The 166.40 ppm peak is a carbonyl carbon, not aromatic. Hence the compound contains 6 aromatic carbons.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
